name: sdlc-traceable-pipeline
description: A 16-agent, traceability-first AI-native SDLC pipeline. Decomposes a large problem into modules, decides the system architecture once per project (C4 model + ADRs), then runs each module through a 14-step chain (Business Req -> Functional Req -> UX -> UI -> Test Scenarios -> Impact Analysis -> Tech Reqs/ER Model -> Security & Performance -> Implementation -> Test Automation -> Test Execution -> Improvement -> Monitoring -> Deploy Docs), with bidirectional traceability, an evidence graph, and named human approval gates at every step.
author: Internal Engineering
